title: AS2 compiler: hoist class field initializers into the constructor so they run for class-linked placed instances (Flash 8 fidelity)
description: DONE (task 1314). FIX: AS2 instance field initializers are now HOISTED into the constructor (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts compileClassDecl step 1b) instead of emitted as ClassName.prototype.x=init. Each instance VarDecl with a non-null init becomes a synthesized 'this.<name> = <init>;' ExprStmt prepended to the ctor body BEFORE the user body (Flash 8 ordering); a class with no explicit ctor gets a synthesized ctor holding just the inits. Step 5 now emits ONLY static fields on the class object; methods+statics+extends/super unchanged (ActionExtends links the proto chain at definition time, so own-property writes are valid before super()). An instance field with no init emits nothing. collectStrings/scanClassDecl updated to match (adds 'this', no 'prototype' for instance fields; ctor excluded from instance-method prototype add). CURRENT vs FIXED: before, a className-linked MovieClip placed/attachMovie'd read the field as undefined->NaN (prototype assignment never applied to such instances); after, the field reads its initialized value per-instance. ACCEPTANCE (Ruffle e2e, byte tests insufficient): NEW apps/desktop/e2e/as2-class-field-init.spec.ts -> '2 passed (15.2s)': (a) class with NO ctor, var n:Number=7 linked+attached traces FIELD=7; (b) class WITH ctor (var n=5; ctor does this.n=this.n+10) traces FIELD=15 (initializer ran first=5, then ctor body +10). Existing as2-class-attach + as2-class-capstone -> '2 passed (15.9s)'. VERIFY: pnpm build green; core src/as2 194 files/3181 tests pass; full core 5394 pass with only 2 pre-existing missing-fixture failures (fixtures/flash8-empty.fla absent in worktree AND main checkout - the allowed ~3 task-1207 fixtures); swf 117 files/1466 tests pass. Docs: docs/12-actionscript.md + CLAUDE.md AS2 learning updated.
